description_en: Set extra configuration for row and column permissions
description_zh: 设置行列权限的额外配置
kebab_example: aliyun quickbi-public set-data-level-permission-extra-config --cube-id 7c7223ae-000000-3c744528014b --rule-type ROW_LEVEL --miss-hit-policy NONE --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDataLevelPermissionExtraConfig

parameters.help_en:
Type of dataset row and column permissions. Possible values:

ROW_LEVEL: Row-level permission
COLUMN_LEVEL: Column-level permission
parameters.help_zh:
数据集行列权限类型。取值范围：

ROW_LEVEL：行级权限
COLUMN_LEVEL：列级权限
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en:
Policy when no rule is matched:

NONE: No permission
ALL: Full permission
parameters.help_zh:
未命中规则时的策略：

NONE：无权限
ALL：拥有所有权限
parameters.name: miss_hit_policy

Result.description_en:
Result of the API execution. Possible values:

true: Request succeeded
false: Request failed
Result.description_zh:
接口执行结果。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败

Success.description_en:
Whether the request was successful. Possible values:

Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
